title: Statutory Classification Record
description: Output of the Primary Text Agent (PTA). Represents the baseline GRI-derived classification from tariff heading text alone, before any ruling is consulted.

component_ref.description: engineering handoff entity ID from taxonomy-handoff.md (e.g. ent_042)

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction whose tariff schedule was used for this classification

hs_code_candidate.description: 4 or 6-digit HS code derived from heading text

gri_path_taken.description: GRI rules applied in sequence. Cannot start at GRI_3b without GRI_1 record.

pre_gri_exclusion_applied.description: Which Pre-GRI Exclusion Filter fired, or 'none' if all passed

pre_gri_exclusion_note_text.description: Exact statutory text of the note that fired. Required when pre_gri_exclusion_applied != 'none'

pre_gri_exclusion_rationale.description: Component-specific explanation for why the filter applies. Required when pre_gri_exclusion_applied != 'none'

exclusion_checks_run.description: All three filters must be listed as checked regardless of outcome

competing_headings_before_resolution.description: Headings that were plausibly applicable before GRI resolution

heading_text_cited.description: Exact statutory heading text from the tariff schedule that determined the classification

section_chapter_note_cited.description: Exact text of any Section or Chapter Note that was determinative

classification_stability_preliminary.description: PTA's initial stability assessment before rulings are consulted

requires_gri_3b.description: True if component is composite and requires full essential character analysis

source_doc.description: Exact filename from source_repo/corpus/. No record accepted without this.
